notes: Encodes as ongoing_effect (concentration 10 min). Main attachment is the storm cloud cylinder (60 ft radius, 10 ft tall). InitialPhase is a Dex save_gate with a 5-ft sphere attachment capturing the bolt's per-point target area. The on_caster_spends_action (Magic) operation fires the same Dex save_gate for subsequent bolts. Slot-scaling (+1d10 per slot above 3) uses linear_per_level on axis=slot. One mechanic deliberately omitted as DM-agenda: the outdoor-storm situational +1d10 bonus (environment-determined, no deterministic surface trigger).
